payload.claim: Change the view if (a) reported gross margin expands more than ~150bp year-on-year on a currency-neutral basis with no tariff-refund or other one-off benefit in the bridge, (b) Greater China currency-neutral revenue decline narrows to single digits for two consecutive quarters, or (c) management raises rather than trims the H2 FY2027 outlook and wholesale sell-through data shows share stabilising versus On/Hoka. On the other side, revisit negatively if promotional intensity deepens, inventory days rise again, or the integrity gate escalates from Flag toward the supply-chain forced-labour inquiry producing a substantiated finding that touches sourcing costs.

prediction.reasoning: FY2026's 6.7% net margin was propped up by a one-off IEEPA tariff refund worth ~$0.52 of Q4 EPS (adjusted Q4 EPS $0.20), so the underlying run-rate is closer to 5.3%; with H1 FY2027 guided to declining revenue, elevated promotional discounting and continued China weakness, I expect FY2027 net margin to stay below the flattered FY2026 level — which is inconsistent with the 5.9% owner-earnings growth the price already embeds.
